trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Customer states the initial problem of not receiving the order.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी एक आठवड्यापूर्वी order केला होता, माझा पार्सल अजून आला नाही.

steps.purpose: Agent asks for identity verification factors.
steps.text: नमस्कार. मी तुमची नक्कीच मदत करेन. सुरक्षेसाठी, कृपया तुमचा order ID आणि registered pincode सांगू शकाल का?

steps.purpose: Customer provides order ID and pincode.
steps.text: हो, order ID आहे ORD-30001 आणि registered pincode 411001 आहे.

steps.purpose: Agent calls the verification tool.
Tool returns verification success.
Agent acknowledges verification.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची माहिती verify झाली आहे. मी तुमची order check करतो.

steps.purpose: Agent looks up order details.
Tool returns order details.
Agent explains the order delay.
steps.text: मला दिसत आहे की तुमची bluetooth headphones ची order, जिची किंमत 2499 रुपये आहे, ती shipped झाली आहे. ही order 5 दिवसांत मिळायला हवी होती, पण आता 9 दिवस झाले आहेत.

steps.purpose: Customer demands to know the exact location of the order.
steps.text: हो, तेच तर! 9 दिवस झाले. मग नक्की कुठे आहे माझा order? तुम्ही लोक फक्त shipped सांगता.

steps.purpose: Agent tracks the shipment.
Tool returns shipment status and exception.
Agent informs the customer about the weather delay.
steps.text: मी courier चं status check केलं. तुमचं पार्सल BlueDart कडे आहे आणि त्यांचं last scan Mumbai Hub चं आहे. तिथे weather delay मुळे delivery ला वेळ लागत आहे.

steps.purpose: Customer disputes the weather delay reason.
steps.text: Weather delay? इथे तर ऊन पडलंय. तुम्ही मला खोटं सांगत आहात का? हे weather delay चं कारण कुठून आलं?

steps.purpose: Agent clarifies the reason comes from the courier system.
steps.text: मी समजतो तुमचा राग. पण courier ने system मध्ये weather delay हेच exception update केलं आहे. मी माझ्या मनाने काही सांगत नाहीये, ही माहिती BlueDart कडून आली आहे.

steps.purpose: Customer demands a fixed delivery date.
steps.text: मग मला सांगा, हे कधीपर्यंत मिळेल? मला एक fix date द्या.

steps.purpose: Agent refuses to give a fixed date and offers a complaint.
steps.text: क्षमस्व, पण courier कडून fix date आलेली नाही, त्यामुळे मी तुम्हाला चुकीची date देऊ शकत नाही. पण promised window संपली असल्यामुळे मी तुमची delivery complaint raise करू शकतो.

steps.purpose: Customer agrees to raise a complaint.
steps.text: हो, complaint raise करा. मी 2499 रुपये prepaid दिले आहेत, मला लवकरात लवकर माझा order पाहिजे.

steps.purpose: Agent raises the delivery complaint.
Tool returns the complaint ID and resolution days.
Agent provides the complaint ID and timeline.
steps.text: मी तुमची complaint raise केली आहे. तुमचा complaint ID CMP-9988 आहे. ही complaint 3 दिवसांत resolve होईल.

steps.purpose: Customer questions the guarantee of the resolution timeline.
steps.text: 3 दिवसांत resolve होईल याची काय गॅरंटी आहे? आणि 3 दिवसांत नाही झालं तर?

steps.purpose: Agent reiterates the system timeline without false guarantees.
steps.text: system नुसार resolution window 3 दिवसांची आहे. या वेळेत तुम्हाला courier कडून update मिळेल. मी तुम्हाला कोणतीही खोटी गॅरंटी देऊ शकत नाही.

steps.purpose: Customer accepts the resolution and ends the conversation.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. मी 3 दिवस वाट पाहतो.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent explicitly asks for identity verification factors and calls the verification tool before looking up and disclosing any account-specific order details.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all responses in the exact outputs provided by the tools (e.g., citing the weather delay from the courier exception, refusing to provide a fixed date because none was returned, and stating the 3-day resolution window exactly as returned).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

The agent successfully verifies the user's identity before disclosing order details, uses the tools accurately, and strictly grounds their responses in the tool outputs without making false promises. The persona is well-represented, and the language adheres perfectly to the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode.
